tools.name: list_game_datasets
tools.description: List every game-data table PVPWire serves, with its game, contents, and entry count. Cheap orientation call before search_game_data or get_game_dataset. Free, no auth.

tools.name: search_game_data
tools.description: Search PVPWire's independently compiled game-mechanics data by item name or effect text, across every covered game: Diablo 2 runewords, cube recipes, breakpoints, uniques, set items and sets; Path of Exile uniques, keystones and skill gems; Diablo 3 legendary powers and sets. Answers "what does Aether Walker do", "which runeword gives faster cast rate", "poe keystone about energy shield". Free, no auth.

query.description: Item, skill, or effect text, e.g. "Enigma" or "cannot be frozen".

game.description: Limit to one game prefix, e.g. "d2", "poe", "d3". Omit to search all.

dataset.description: Limit to one dataset key, e.g. "runewords".

tools.name: get_game_dataset
tools.description: Fetch a PVPWire game-data table in bulk rather than by lookup: every Diablo 2 runeword, every Path of Exile skill gem, every Diablo 3 set. Paged, because a table can run to thousands of rows. Call list_game_datasets first if you do not know the key. Free, no auth.

game.description: Game prefix, e.g. "d2", "poe", "d3". Call list_game_datasets for the current set.

tools.name: get_gaming_news
tools.description: Ranked competitive-gaming news aggregated by PVPWire from editorial, Reddit, and Steam. Free, no auth. Use source to filter and digest for headline-only rows.

tools.name: get_game_players
tools.description: Live runtime signal for one tracked game across 119 titles: current Steam players, Twitch viewers, and IGDB metadata (genres, rating). Not every game has every signal: titles off Steam (League of Legends, Fortnite) report Twitch and IGDB only. Free, no auth. Pass the catalog slug (e.g. counter-strike-2, marvel-rivals).

tools.name: get_economy_snapshot
tools.description: Latest daily market snapshot for a tracked game economy, from PVPWire's own captured corpus. Free, no auth. Returns item coverage and the day's notable movers. Games: osrs, ffxiv.

tools.name: get_trending_games
tools.description: Live ranked list of what is being played right now, fused from Twitch viewers and Steam players. Free, no auth.

tools.name: find_pvpwire_data
tools.description: Discover which PVPWire endpoint answers a data need. Describe what you want in plain language (e.g. "OSRS item prices", "which shooter is trending", "Diablo 2 runewords") and get the 2 to 3 best-matching endpoints with their path, what they return, and whether they are free or paid. Free, no auth. Use this first when no dedicated tool obviously fits.

query.description: Plain-language description of the data you need.

tools.name: get_economy_arbitrage
tools.description: Cross-market arbitrage verdict for a tracked game economy: the widest sustained buy/sell spread to exploit, computed over PVPWire's own daily corpus. Free preview returns the single top pick (rate limited per client) and covers osrs and ffxiv. Set full=true for the ranked table, volume-based risk flags, data freshness, and an AFTA Ed25519-signed receipt; the paid verdict covers osrs only. Costs 10 credits ($0.10) and requires a PVPWIRE_TOKEN bearer token (buy at https://pvpwire.com/developers/agent-payments).

full.description: true = paid full verdict, osrs only (10 credits, needs PVPWIRE_TOKEN). Omit or false for the free top-pick preview, which also covers ffxiv.

tools.name: get_d2_breakpoint_verdict
tools.description: Diablo 2 breakpoint verdict: which frame tier a class hits at its current fcr/fhr/fbr/ias percent, the next breakpoint and its gap, and (paid) the ranked runewords, uniques and set items that close it. Computed over PVPWire's independently compiled tables. Free preview returns the headline ruling; set full=true for the ranked gear table and an AFTA Ed25519-signed receipt (10 credits, $0.10, needs PVPWIRE_TOKEN).

stat.description: Frame stat: faster cast rate, faster hit recovery, faster block rate, or increased attack speed. Availability varies by class.

current.description: Current percent of the stat. Default 0.

full.description: true = paid full verdict with the ranked gear table (10 credits, needs PVPWIRE_TOKEN). Omit or false for the free preview.
